variants.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Refine the provided Planet desktop companion UI reference. Transparent PNG with real alpha outside objects. Single polished interface design study per image, landscape canvas. This is a software desktop overlay, not physical objects. Preserve floating messages, bottom composer and small perfectly circular orb immediately to its left. No enclosing window, panel, backdrop, desktop wallpaper, floor, shadows, bloom or external glow. A tiny separate idle orb at lower left illustrates collapsed state. Restrained readable modern sans-serif typography.
CRITICAL ORB CHANGE: replace the cloud-heavy texture with a nearly homogeneous smooth blue sphere/disc. Entire sphere is one blue hue, very subtly lighter toward upper left, darker toward lower right; an extremely broad continuous tonal gradient, no visible internal shapes. NO clouds, wisps, marbling, turbulence, speckles, nebula, surface pattern, rings, shine streaks or multicolour. Crisp perfect circular silhouette. This will eventually animate slow tonal movement, but render a static clean frame.
COLOUR: same single blue hue throughout orb, outgoing messages and composer; outgoing/input surfaces use a restrained light blue fill, deep navy text. Assistant messages warm off-white with dark text. Do not use charcoal input or multihue gradients. Every coloured element matches. Keep all edges clean, no luminous spill.
